data.question: Which product categories were in the top 10 by revenue in both 2017 and 2018?

steps: Join orders, order_items, products, and category_translation to calculate total revenue by English product category for 2017, filtering out canceled and unavailable orders.
Join orders, order_items, products, and category_translation to calculate total revenue by English product category for 2018 (up to August), filtering out canceled and unavailable orders.
Identify the top 10 categories by revenue for 2017 and the top 10 categories for 2018.
Find the intersection of both top 10 lists to determine which categories were in the top 10 in both years.

args.purpose: Find top 10 product categories by revenue in 2017 and 2018 (up to August)
args.sql:
WITH rev_2017 AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS category,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND extract(year FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY revenue DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
rev_2018 AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS category,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND extract(year FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
      AND extract(month FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY revenue DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(a.category, b.category) AS category,
    a.revenue AS revenue_2017,
    b.revenue AS revenue_2018
FROM rev_2017 a
FULL OUTER JOIN rev_2018 b ON a.category = b.category
ORDER BY COALESCE(a.revenue, b.revenue) DESC

args.sql:
WITH t2017 AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS category,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) as rk
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND extract(year FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
    GROUP BY 1
),
t2018 AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS category,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) as rk
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND extract(year FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(a.category, b.category) AS category,
    a.rk AS rank_2017,
    a.revenue AS revenue_2017,
    b.rk AS rank_2018,
    b.revenue AS revenue_2018
FROM (SELECT * FROM t2017 WHERE rk <= 10) a
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM t2018 WHERE rk <= 10) b ON a.category = b.category
ORDER BY LEAST(COALESCE(a.rk, 99), COALESCE(b.rk, 99))

q7.sql:
WITH t2017 AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS category
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND extract(year FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
t2018 AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS category
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND extract(year FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
      AND extract(month FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
intersection AS (
    SELECT category FROM t2017
    INTERSECT
    SELECT category FROM t2018
)
SELECT string_agg(category, ', ' ORDER BY category) AS categories_list, count(*) AS cnt
FROM intersection

WITH rev_2017 AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS category,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND extract(year FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY revenue DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
rev_2018 AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS category,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND extract(year FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
      AND extract(month FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY revenue DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(a.category, b.category) AS category,
    a.revenue AS revenue_2017,
    b.revenue AS revenue_2018
FROM rev_2017 a
FULL OUTER JOIN rev_2018 b ON a.category = b.category
ORDER BY COALESCE(a.revenue, b.revenue) DESC

WITH t2017 AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS category,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) as rk
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND extract(year FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
    GROUP BY 1
),
t2018 AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS category,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) as rk
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND extract(year FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(a.category, b.category) AS category,
    a.rk AS rank_2017,
    a.revenue AS revenue_2017,
    b.rk AS rank_2018,
    b.revenue AS revenue_2018
FROM (SELECT * FROM t2017 WHERE rk <= 10) a
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM t2018 WHERE rk <= 10) b ON a.category = b.category
ORDER BY LEAST(COALESCE(a.rk, 99), COALESCE(b.rk, 99))
